app_info.subtitle: Branded video without a shoot
app_info.description:
WyvStudio turns a prompt, a script, an article or your own product images into a finished vertical video: script, scenes, stock or AI visuals, narration in your chosen voice, captions and an MP4. It also plans and makes UGC-style ads with AI presenters or your own consented characters.

Connected to ChatGPT, the assistant can do nearly everything you do in the app: make a video and watch it render, read a video scene by scene and change any of it (re-voice, swap or generate visuals, animate, captions, music), show you a scene or a character as a picture in the chat, export in any ratio, share a public watch link, and publish or schedule to a connected YouTube, TikTok, Instagram or Facebook account after you confirm the exact post.

Spending is never a surprise. Anything that costs credits is estimated first, the estimate is shown to you with your balance, and the work only starts after you approve that specific quote. The same plan limits, credits and consent rules as the app apply.

test_cases.description: Quoting before spending. The assistant reads the workspace with get_capabilities, then calls estimate_video and shows the 24-30 credit range against the balance and asks for approval. No video is created and no credits move.
test_cases.user_prompt: Make a 20-second vertical video from this script: A standing desk pays for itself. You sit less, you focus more, and your back stops complaining. Stock footage is fine.
test_cases.expected_output: The plan, balance and limits, then a quote_id with credits.min/max of about 24-30 and can_afford. The assistant asks before creating.

test_cases.description: Approval then creation. Against the quote from the previous turn the assistant calls create_video, polls get_video_status to completed and returns the MP4 from get_video_result. Takes about two minutes and spends about 12 credits.
test_cases.expected_output: A video id, status completed, credits.spent, and a private time-limited download_url.

test_cases.description: Editing an existing video. The assistant reads the project, prices the change with propose_edits at 3 credits, asks, and only then calls apply_edits.
test_cases.expected_output: A proposal with credits.max 3, then applied[0].ok true after approval.

test_cases.description: Public sharing and revoking it again, showing the open-world tool is reversible. share_video returns a /sample/ URL that plays logged out; the same tool with enabled false turns it off.
test_cases.user_prompt: Give me a public link to watch it, then turn it off.
test_cases.expected_output: shared true with a share_url that loads logged out, then shared false and share_url null.

test_cases.description: UGC planning and pricing with no generation. plan_ugc builds a shot plan, estimate_ugc prices it at about 210 credits and the assistant asks. No take allowance is consumed.
test_cases.user_prompt: Plan a 10-second UGC ad for a standing desk with a described presenter and tell me the cost.
test_cases.expected_output: A quote_id, the credit total and pricing.takes 1. Nothing is generated.

negative_test_cases.description: Spending without a current approved quote. create_video is refused with quote_expired or for a missing quote; the assistant re-estimates and asks again rather than proceeding.
